title: Appendix A — The Empty Net Gamble: Analyzing the Relationship Between Pull Time and Timing
text:
Team name: BarDown
Team member names: Feride, Apiu, Tanisha
Research questions:

Does pulling the goalie increase the probability of a tie?
Does pulling the goalie increase the probability of a win in overtime?
Does pulling the goalie lead to more opposing team empty net goals?

Motivation: We like hockey, and pulling the goalie has been a heavily contested play.
Datasets: fastRhockey library. This has data on PWHL (Women’s hockey) and NHL (Men’s hockey).
Communication plan: Google Chat, response time within 24 hours, 12-1 on Tuesdays.
Roles:

Technical lead: Apiu
Point-of-contact: Tanisha
Style lead: Feride

Conflict resolution:

Communicate beforehand if you expect to miss a deadline.
Talk through disagreements.
